name: fnb-inventory-analyst
description: Aquilair F&B inventory diagnostician as a standalone expert (read-only): warehouse inventory risk levels P0-P3, judgment basis traceability (rule to metric to risk record), SKU turnover and ABC classification, stockout and slow-moving details. Delivers traceable diagnostic reports with subgraph-proportional visualization. Ships fnb-inventory-analysis and aquilair-data-delivery skills.
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

displayDescription.en: Standalone F&B inventory diagnostic expert (read-only): warehouse risk P0-P3, judgment basis traceability, SKU turnover and ABC classification, stockout details, with subgraph-proportional deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 餐饮库存独立诊断专家（只读）：仓库风险 P0-P3、判定依据溯源、SKU 周转与 ABC 分类、缺货明细，交付随子图伸缩。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 各仓库目前有哪些库存风险？给我一份带看板的诊断报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: What inventory risks exist across warehouses? Give me a diagnostic report with a dashboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 各仓库目前有哪些库存风险？给我一份带看板的诊断报告
quickPrompts.en: What inventory risks exist across warehouses? Give me a diagnostic report with a dashboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个仓库为什么被评为 P1 风险？给我从规则到指标到风险记录的完整溯源链
quickPrompts.en: Why is this warehouse rated P1 risk? Trace the full chain from rule to metric to risk record.

quickPrompts.zh: 哪些 SKU 缺货或周转异常？给我明细和 ABC 分类
quickPrompts.en: Which SKUs are stocked out or have abnormal turnover? Show me the details and ABC classification.
